upstream.description: [Nature Reviews Bioengineering🔥] Application of Large Language Models in Medicine.  A curated list of practical guide resources of Medical LLMs (Medical LLMs Tree, Tables, and Papers)

classification.analysis: MedLLMsPracticalGuide is a curated, actively maintained awesome-list accompanying a Nature Reviews Bioengineering survey paper on applying Large Language Models in medicine. It catalogs papers, models, and datasets across the medical LLM pipeline: pre-training from scratch, fine-tuning, prompting, clinical data sources, downstream biomedical tasks (summarization, QA, entity extraction, RAG), clinical applications (decision-making, coding, report generation), and open challenges (hallucination, evaluation, ethics). Aimed at researchers and practitioners building or evaluating medical/clinical LLMs, maintained by an academic consortium (Oxford, Imperial, MIT, Harvard among others) with periodic updates.

use_cases.title: Find published medical LLM papers organized by pipeline stage
Research which fine-tuning or RAG approaches work for clinical applications
Survey open challenges in medical LLM evaluation and safety
